sections.title: ERN NY/NRN NJ AND CNTRL/SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: MID-LVL JET STREAK CURRENTLY OVER THE UPR GRTLKS WILL DIG SEWD INTO PA/NJ BY TUESDAY AFTN AS THE UPR LOW OVER ONTARIO REMAINS IN PLACE. NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG/N OF THE JET AXIS WHERE H5 TEMPERATURES AOB MINUS 18 DEG C COMBINE WITH MODEST LLVL MOISTURE. WHILE ISOLD STORMS ACROSS FAR NRN NY EWD INTO NH COULD PRODUCE GUSTY WINDS/HAIL...PRIMARY SVR THREAT SHOULD BE RELEGATED TO SERN NY/NRN NJ EWD INTO CNTRL/SRN NEW ENGLAND INCLUDING NYC METRO. HERE...WLY H5 FLOW IN EXCESS OF 60 KTS WILL BOOST BULK SHEAR TO 40+ KTS AMIDST MLCAPES 500-1000 J/KG. ISOLD SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS AN ISOLD TORNADO. ACTIVITY SHOULD EVOLVE INTO ENEWD MOVING CLUSTERS AND WEAKEN AS THEY APPROACH CSTL SERN NEW ENGLAND BY TUESDAY EVENING.

sections.title: MO VLY AND CORN BELT
sections.text: A FAIRLY ROBUST MID-LVL IMPULSE CURRENTLY TIED TO TSTMS OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS IS FCST TO TOP THE RIDGE AXIS OVER THE DKTS...THEN DIG SEWD THROUGH THE CORN BELT BY TUESDAY NIGHT. A WEAK SFC LOW WILL CORRESPONDINGLY DEVELOP EWD ACROSS CNTRL SD INVOF A WRMFNT THAT WILL EXTEND SEWD INTO CNTRL IA. AIR MASS ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY SOUTH OF THE FRONT WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS AVERAGING IN THE MID 60S ALONG WITH STRONG HEATING AND MID-LVL LAPSE RATES OF 7 DEG C PER KM. THIS WILL YIELD MLCAPES OF 2000-3000 J/KG WITH A FORMIDABLE CAP UNTIL MID-AFTN. COMBINATION OF VERY UNSTABLE CONDITIONS AND APPROACH OF THE MID-LVL IMPULSE SHOULD WEAKEN MLCINH AND RESULT IN SFC-BASED TSTM INITIATION OVER SCNTRL ND/CNTRL SD BY MID-AFTN. FCST HODOGRAPHS EXHIBIT A STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILE IN THE LOWEST 4-6KM AND GIVEN SUCH STEEP LAPSE RATES...SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND ISOLD TORNADOES WILL BE LIKELY WITH INITIAL STORMS...ESPECIALLY OVER CNTRL SD AND NCNTRL NEB. ACTIVITY WILL CONGLOMERATE INTO A NOCTURNAL MCS AND MOVE SEWD INTO NRN NEB AND NWRN IA WITH CONTINUED THREATS FOR GUSTY WINDS/HAIL. OTHER STORMS WILL FORM FARTHER E INVOF THE WRMFNT ACROSS NRN/CNTRL IA DURING PEAK HEATING. B

sections.title: SRN STATES
sections.text: TSTMS WILL FOCUS ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES/SEABREEZES AND ALONG PRIMARY BAROCLINIC ZONE FROM THE SRN STATES WWD INTO COASTAL BEND OF TX. FLOW REGIME WILL BE RATHER WEAK...BUT RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND POCKETS OF STRONG HEATING BENEATH AT LEAST MODEST CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT WILL PROBABLY YIELD ISOLD ORGANIZED STORMS WITH POTENTIAL WET MICROBURSTS. ACTIVITY WILL DIMINISH AFTER DARK.

sections.title: SWRN/SCNTRL MT
sections.text: REGION WILL REMAIN IN NEUTRAL TO WEAKLY CYCLONIC FLOW DOWNSTREAM OF AN UPR TROUGH OVER THE PAC NW ON TUESDAY. THOUGH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE WILL BE LESS THAN MONDAY...COLDER TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND DIURNAL UPSLOPE WILL YIELD ISOLD HIGH-BASED MOUNTAIN STORMS DURING THE AFTN. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLD LARGE HAIL ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND PERHAPS GUSTY WINDS ALONG THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS DURING THE EVENING. OTHER BANDS OF ELEVATED SUB-SVR STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM UPSTREAM OVER ID AND WRN MT TUESDAY NIGHT AS THE PRIMARY WAVE EJECTS ACROSS THE REGION. ..RACY/HURLBUT.. 07/07/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: OVERALL LARGE SCALE PATTERN CHANGING LITTLE AS STUBBORN UPPER LOW REMAINS JUST N OF THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND PRIMARY TROUGH SLOWLY SHIFTS INLAND PAC NW. RIDGE POSITION EXTENDS FROM NRN PLAINS SWWD TO UPPER HIGH NRN MEXICO.

sections.title: SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: THE NEXT IN A SERIES OF IMPULSES/WIND MAX THAT HAVE BEEN ROTATING AROUND THE UPPER LOW...CURRENTLY WELL DEPICTED ON W/V IMAGERY MOVING EWD ACROSS LOWER GREAT LAKES. THIS TRACK WILL BRING THE COLD CYCLONIC SIDE OF THE WIND MAX ACROSS SRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON. WITH PWS AROUND AN INCH...LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 7C/KM AND 500 MB TEMPS -17 T0 -19C...ALL THAT IS NEEDED WILL BE A FEW HOURS OF HEATING TO INITIATE THUNDERSTORMS. EARLY VISIBLE IMAGERY...OUTSIDE OF FOG IN THE RIVER VALLEYS...HAS LITTLE CLOUD COVER SERN NY/WRN MA INTO NERN PA. ONCE SFC TEMPS REACH LOW/MID 70S...STRONG CONVECTION SHOULD DEVELOP WITH ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTING LARGE HAIL IN MOST VIGOROUS UPDRAFTS. SUFFICIENT SHEAR ASSOCIATED WITH 60KT 500 WIND MAX FOR POSSIBLE ROTATING STORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON. THIS WOULD INCREASE THREAT OF NOT ONLY LARGE HAIL...BUT LOCAL DAMAGING WINDS AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO. THREAT AREA WILL BE CONSTRAINED ON THE EAST BY EXPECTED MORE CLOUDS AND STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS COASTAL AREAS OF NEW ENGLAND AND MUCH OF MAINE.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: COLD FRONT HAS ENTERED WRN ND/SD THIS AM AND WILL BE A FOCUS FOR POTENTIAL SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS IT ENCOUNTERS A FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...ACROSS CENTRAL SD. ALTHOUGH AREA IS JUST E OF MID/UPR RIDGE...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND WARM ADVECTION COUPLED WITH STRONG SURFACE HEATING...THE AIR MASS BY LATE AFTERNOON WILL BE QUITE UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPES AOA 2000 J/KG WITH ONLY WEAK CINH. THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP IN AREA OF FAVORABLE LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE VICINITY FRONT AND THEN MOVE/PROPAGATE SEWD THRU THIS EVENING INTO NRN NEB AND NWRN IA. STRONG VEERING SHEAR PROFILES WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS. GIVEN THE SHEAR/INSTABILITY EXPECTED VERY LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY ISOLATED TORNADOES ARE POSSIBLE THRU THE EVENING CENTRAL SD INTO NRN NEB. STORMS WILL LIKELY GROW UPSCALE INTO AN MCS THIS EVENING WITH ASSOCIATED WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL.

sections.title: SWRN/SCENTRAL MT
sections.text: ALTHOUGH MOISTURE LESS THAN ON MON...OVERALL PARAMETERS REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR STRONG/ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS AGAIN TODAY PARTS OF SWRN MT. WITH GRADUAL APPROACH OF UPSTREAM TROUGH...DEEP LAYER SHEAR COUPLED WITH STEEP...COOL MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORT LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS WITH STORMS THAT DEVELOP OFF HIGHER TERRAIN BY MID AFTERNOON. ACTIVITY NOT EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS ERN MT AS LAST NIGHT AS AIR MASS NOT EXPECTED TO BE VERY UNSTABLE NEAR THE RIDGE POSITION.

sections.title: TX PANHANDLE
sections.text: AGAIN VEERING SHEAR PROFILES ALONG WITH VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES TO SUPPORT AT LEAST ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS VICINITY TX PANHANDLE LATER THIS AFTERNOON E OF UPPER RIDGE. THREAT APPEARS TO BE LESS THAN ON MON AFTERNOON AS UPPER HEIGHTS GRADUALLY RISE AND MID LEVEL TEMPS WARM.

sections.title: NORTHEAST STATES
sections.text: A FLAT UPPER TROUGH IS PRESENT THIS MORNING OVER THE NORTHEAST UNITED STATES...WHILE AN UPPER RIDGE HOLDS FIRM ACROSS THE SOUTHERN ROCKIES AND PLAINS. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SUGGESTS A RATHER POTENT MID LEVEL SPEED MAX IS ROTATING ACROSS NY/PA AND INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON. POCKETS OF DAYTIME HEATING AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MODERATE INSTABILITY LATER TODAY WITH MUCAPE VALUES OF 1000-2000 J/KG. COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR WILL PROMOTE ORGANIZED THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS. MULTIPLE BANDS OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE AS ACTIVITY REDEVELOPS BEHIND INITIAL ACTIVITY MOVING ACROSS NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS AND UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS PERSISTED OVERNIGHT ACROSS MT/ND...AND IS NOW BEGINNING TO AFFECT PARTS OF SD. THESE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INTENSIFY LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF SD/IA/NEB/MN. WEAK UPPER RIDGING ACROSS THE AREA LIMITS CONFIDENCE IN AREAL COVERAGE OF SEVERE STORMS TODAY. HOWEVER...MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY AND PERSISTENCE OF CONVECTIVE CLUSTER SUGGESTS ENHANCED SEVERE PROBABILITIES REMAIN WARRANTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA. PLEASE REFER TO SWOMCD NUMBER 1472 FOR FURTHER DETAILS.

sections.title: KS/OK
sections.text: A SMALL CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED THIS MORNING NEAR ICT. THESE STORMS APPEAR TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK MID LEVEL VORT MAX THAT AIDED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT YESTERDAY AFTERNOON OVER CENTRAL CO. THIS FEATURE WILL CONTINUE TO DRIFT EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD TODAY AND MAY HELP TO INITIATE FURTHER CONVECTION. 12Z NAM AND WRF-NMM RUNS SUGGEST AN INCREASED RISK OF THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL OK...SO HAVE ADJUSTED THIS OUTLOOK ACCORDINGLY.

sections.title: SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ONCE AGAIN TODAY ALONG AN AXIS FROM EASTERN CO/WESTERN NEB INTO WEST TX. UPPER RIDGING SHOULD LIMIT EXTENT OF STORMS. HOWEVER...ANY STORM THAT DOES DEVELOP WILL POSE A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.

sections.title: MT
sections.text: STRONG SOUTHWEST FLOW ALOFT WILL MAINTAIN FAVORABLE VERTICAL SHEAR ACROSS MUCH OF MT TODAY. REMNANT DEWPOINTS IN THE 40S OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF SOUTHWEST MT ALONG WITH STRONG HEATING MAY LEAD TO ISOLATED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORMS. HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGER CELLS...ALTHOUGH ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ALONG REMNANT BOUNDARY EXTENDING ACROSS THE GULF COAST STATES INTO THE SOUTHEAST. A FEW WET MICROBURSTS ARE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART/SMITH/COOK.. 07/07/2009

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLAINS
sections.text: UNCERTAINTY REMAINS OVER THE AREAL COVERAGE...INTENSITY AND MODE OF TSTM ACTIVITY THROUGH TONIGHT GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF WEAK MID/UPPER-LEVEL RIDGING. THUS...HAVE REMOVED HIGHER SIGNIFICANT HAIL PROBABILITIES. WILL STILL MAINTAIN HIGHER HAIL/WIND PROBABILITIES ACROSS SERN SD WHERE ONGOING CLUSTER OVER E-CNTRL SD MAY EVOLVE/DEVELOP SEWD...WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE INVOF MESOLOW NEAR SERN SD.

sections.title: NORTHEAST
sections.text: PROBABILITIES ADJUSTED TO REFLECT THE ONGOING MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL/LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND EVENT THAT CONSISTS PRIMARILY OF TWO AREAS OF CONCENTRATED TSTM ACTIVITY. THE INITIAL CLUSTER OVER SRN NEW ENGLAND SHOULD MOVE OFFSHORE BY 21-22Z...WHILE ADDITIONAL SCATTERED TSTMS ARE CURRENTLY APPROACHING THE HUDSON VALLEY. SOME RECOVERY HAS OCCURRED BETWEEN THESE TWO AREAS AND SHOULD BE THE MAIN FOCUS FOR ADDITIONAL SEVERE TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON. ELSEWHERE...MINOR CHANGES MADE TO TSTM/5% SEVERE PROBABILITIES BASED ON OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS. PLEASE REFER TO LATEST WATCHES AND MCDS FOR MORE SPECIFIC SHORT-TERM FORECASTS. ..GRAMS/DIAL.. 07/07/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1120 AM CDT TUE JUL 07 2009/
